name: supo-codegym-egressprobe-h100
description: 1-GPU probe: can pods reach huggingface.co / PyPI / GitHub, and how fast?

job_template_config.entrypoint_full_script: for u in https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct/resolve/main/config.json https://pypi.org/simple/torch/ https://github.com/StigLidu/CodeGym https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu129/torch/; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -L "$u"); echo "EGRESS $u -> $code"; done; env | grep -i proxy; t0=$(date +%s); curl -sL --max-time 300 -o /tmp/shard.bin "https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct/resolve/main/model-00017-of-00017.safetensors"; sz=$(stat -c %s /tmp/shard.bin 2>/dev/null || echo 0); echo "EGRESS hf download $((sz/1000000)) MB in $(( $(date +%s)-t0 )) s"; exit 0
